title: The Frame Machine
description: The Frame Machine makes your game smother for a better experience
body:
Short Summary:
   A client and server-side optimization modpack designed to drastically boost FPS, eliminate stuttering, and reduce lag without altering the vanilla experience.
                             
                             
                               About This Modpack:
   Say goodbye to lag spikes and low frame rates. The Frame Machine is a carefully curated, lightweight collection of performance-enhancing mods handpicked to maximize your Minecraft performance. Whether you are exploring massive worlds in singleplayer or playing on busy multiplayer servers, this pack ensures your game runs buttery smooth.
   
                             Why Should You Download It?
  Maximized FPS: Drastically increases your frame rates and improves overall game rendering efficiency. Lag Reduction: Eliminates common micro-stutters and drastically decreases chunk loading times. Optimized Server & Client: Includes performance tweaks for both singleplayer and multiplayer environments.Vanilla Friendly: The core gameplay remains exactly the same. No unwanted content or game-breaking features are added.
